blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Survival research in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is limited by the scarcity of datasets linking whole-slide histology with clinical, molecular, and long-term outcome data. We present a retrospective single-centre cohort of 302 patients who underwent PDAC resection at University Medical Center Göttingen. The dataset comprises 446 H&E whole-slide images, clinicopathological variables, targeted sequencing data for 154 patients, and overall-survival outcomes. During follow-up, 253 patients died, and the median follow-up was 76 months. To establish initial reference values, we evaluated fourteen survival-prediction configurations using identical five-repetition Monte Carlo cross-validation partitions. Ridge Cox regression using numeric clinicopathological variables achieved a mean concordance of 0.649 ± 0.042 0.649\pm 0.042 and 0.652 ± 0.046 0.652\pm 0.046 after adding KRAS and TP53 mutation status. The image-only attention model achieved 0.603 ± 0.030 0.603\pm 0.030 , while multimodal fusion achieved 0.619 ± 0.025 0.619\pm 0.025 , the highest concordance among the neural models. These results establish promising initial benchmarks for future research using this pancreas-specific multimodal dataset, paving the way for external validation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pancreatic cancer remains one of the most lethal solid tumors, with an estimated 511,000 new cases and 467,000 deaths worldwide in 2022 alone [ 1 ] . Although the five-year relative survival for cancer overall has now reached a historic milestone of 70%, survival for pancreatic cancer remains below 15%, the lowest of any major solid tumor [ 2 ] . This gap reflects both late-stage diagnosis and a limited ability to identify patients who have undergone resection into those likely to benefit from adjuvant therapy and those at highest risk of early recurrence. Reliable, individualized prognosis is therefore essential, helping guide treatment decisions, identify patients for clinical trials, and plan follow-up after surgery.
blocks.zh: 胰腺癌仍是最致命的固体肿瘤之一,估计仅2022年全球就有511,000例新病例,467,000人死亡[1]. 虽然癌症的五年相对存活率目前已达到70%的历史里程碑,但胰腺癌的存活率仍然低于15%,是任何重大固体肿瘤中最低的[2]。 这一差距既反映了晚期诊断,也反映了确定哪些病人被重新剖析为可能受益于辅助疗法的人和那些最有可能早复发的人的能力有限。 因此,可靠的、个性化的预测至关重要,有助于指导治疗决定,确定临床试验的病人,并计划手术后的后续行动。

blocks.en: Clinical prognosis in resected pancreatic cancer still relies primarily on TNM stage together with a small set of pathology-report variables such as grade, margin status, and lymph node ratio. Yet multi-institutional validation of the current AJCC staging system has repeatedly shown wide survival overlap between stages and strong heterogeneity within the same stage [ 3 ] . Transcriptomic profiling has revealed that pancreatic tumors segregate into biologically distinct subtypes (e.g., classical versus basal-like, or squamous, immunogenic, and ADEX subtypes) with markedly different outcomes that are not captured by stage alone [ 4 , 5 ] . These findings indicate that stage-based, single-variable prognostic schemes disregard clinically relevant biological information, motivating approaches that jointly model histomorphology, clinical covariates, and molecular measurements rather than treating them as separate, competing sources of evidence.
blocks.zh: 重新剖腹产的胰腺癌的临床预后仍然主要依赖于TNM阶段,以及一小组病理-报告变量,如等级,比值状态,淋巴结比. 然而,对AJCC现有中转系统的多机构验证一再表明,同一阶段的阶段和强烈的异质性之间存在着广泛的生存重叠[3]。 缩写图解显示,胰腺瘤分化成生物上截然不同的亚型(例如,古典类与玄武岩类,或类固醇类,免疫型,和ADEX亚型),其结果明显不同,仅阶段[4,5]无法捕捉到. 这些研究结果表明,基于阶段的单一可变预测方案忽略了与临床相关的生物信息,激发了联合建模常态学、临床共变论和分子测量的方法,而不是将它们作为单独、相互竞争的证据来源。

blocks.en:
Outside of pancreatic cancer, integrating whole-slide histology with molecular and clinical data has repeatedly improved survival prediction relative to any single modality. Early work combining convolutional features from H&E images with genomic markers in glioma outperformed models built on either modality alone [ 6 ] . Other architectures such as Pathomic Fusion [ 7 ] , multimodal co-attention transformers [ 8 ] , and encoder-based multimodal survival models trained across cancer types [ 9 ] have shown that attention- and fusion-based combinations of image and omics data improves model performance. In parallel, vision-language pathology
foundation models adapted through multi-granular prompt learning have improved label-efficient whole-slide representation learning under limited annotation [ 10 ] , pointing to a complementary route toward richer histology encoders. These results show that combining histology with molecular and clinical data is a promising direction in computational oncology.
blocks.zh:
在胰腺癌之外,将全滑石神学与分子和临床数据相结合,使存活率预测相对于任何单一模式都得到了反复改进. 早期的工作结合了H&E图像的演化特征和光靠两种模式构建的胶原体的基因组标记。 其他建筑如Pathomic Fusion [7],多式联运共关注变压器[8],以及经过癌症类型培训的编码器多模式生存模型[9]都表明,基于关注和聚变的图像和动漫数据的组合提高了模型性能. 同时,视觉语言病理学
通过多角即时学习而改编的基础模型,在有限的注释下改进了标签效率的全滑表示学习[10],指出了向更丰富的神学编码器的互补途径. 这些结果显示,将组织学与分子和临床数据结合起来,是计算肿瘤学的一个很有希望的方向.

blocks.en: Translating this to pancreatic cancer, however, is not easy. Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is a particularly demanding setting for multimodal fusion as tumor cellularity in resection specimens is often low and diluted within a dense desmoplastic stroma [ 11 ] . Additionally, morphological presentation is heterogeneous even within a single tumor, and, as detailed in Section 2.1 , the public resources needed to jointly develop and validate such models (histology paired with both structured clinical follow-up and molecular data at survival-relevant scale) remain scarce. As a result, prior pancreas-specific studies have largely evaluated a single modality at a time, or have folded a small pancreatic subset into a pan-cancer multimodal benchmark rather than modeling the disease by itself (Section 2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 然而,将它转化为胰腺癌并不容易。 由于重新剖面标本中的肿瘤细胞性通常较低,在密集的脱塑性血压中稀释,因此泛链性胶囊瘤是多模式聚变的一个特别苛刻的环境[11]. 此外,即使是在单一肿瘤中,形态特征也各不相同,如第2.1节所详述的,共同开发和验证这种模型所需的公共资源(历史学与结构化的临床跟踪和与生存有关的分子数据相结合)仍然稀缺。 因此,先前的胰腺特异性研究基本上一次评估一种单一模式,或者将一个小的胰腺子集成成为泛癌多模式基准,而不是自己模拟这种疾病(第2.2节)。

blocks.en: In this work, we address this gap by introducing a large, multi-slide pancreatic cancer histopathology cohort with matched clinical variables and targeted mutation-panel sequencing (described in Section 2.1 ), together with an initial multimodal benchmark for overall-survival prediction. Specifically, we (i) learn slide-level representations from H&E whole-slide images (WSI) and combine them with structured clinical covariates and mutation status within a shared survival-modeling framework; (ii) benchmark this multimodal approach against unimodal and pairwise-modality baselines to quantify the contribution of histology, clinical data, and mutation status individually and in combination; and (iii) report these results as initial reference values rather than a definitive modeling strategy, so that the resulting dataset and benchmarks together provide a reproducible, pancreas-specific test set for future multimodal survival-prediction research. We hope that this resource lowers the barrier to future work integrating histomorphology and molecular profiling for pancreatic cancer, a disease where prognostic improvement remains most urgently needed.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过引入一个大型、多滑坡性胰腺癌组织病理学组群,并配有相应的临床变量和有针对性的突变-小板排列顺序(见第2.1节),以及总体生存预测的初步多式联运基准,来弥补这一差距。 具体地说,我们(一) 从H&E全滑图象(WSI)中学习幻灯片水平的表示,并在共同生存模型框架内将其与结构化的临床共变和突变状态相结合;(二) 将这一多式联运方法与单式和双式模式基线作为基准,以量化组织学、临床数据和突变状态各自和组合的贡献;(三) 将这些结果报告为初步参考值,而不是确定的模式化战略,以便由此产生的数据集和基准共同为未来的多式联运生存预测研究提供一个可复制的、全景特异的测试。 我们希望,这一资源能够减少今后工作的障碍,将胰腺癌的形态学和分子剖面分析结合起来,而这种疾病仍然是最迫切需要的。

blocks.en: 2.1 Public histopathology resources for pancreatic cancer
blocks.zh: 2.1 胰腺癌的公共组织病理学资源

blocks.en:
Progress in computational pathology for pancreatic cancer has been limited by
the scarcity of public whole-slide images (WSIs) linked to patient-level
outcomes. The public data landscape is dominated by two US consortium cohorts.
The Cancer Genome Atlas pancreatic adenocarcinoma cohort (TCGA-PAAD) contains
185 cases with multi-omic profiling and clinical follow-up [ 12 ] . After histologic review and quality control,
however, image-based studies typically retain only approximately 120-170
patients, often represented by a single diagnostic formalin-fixed slide [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . The
Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium pancreatic cohort (CPTAC-PDA)
provides 557 WSIs from 168 subjects, together with extensive proteogenomic
characterization [ 16 ] . Thus, although
TCGA-PAAD and CPTAC-PDA provide the most comprehensive public resources for
outcome-oriented studies, each contains fewer than 200 patients.

blocks.en: 2.2 Computational pathology of pancreatic cancer
blocks.zh: 2.2 胰腺癌的计算病理学

blocks.en:
Existing methods can be grouped into diagnosis, molecular characterization,
prognosis, and tissue quantification. For diagnosis, convolutional and
multiple-instance learning (MIL) models have detected pancreatic ductal
adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in resection WSIs and endoscopic-ultrasound-guided
fine-needle biopsies, while related systems support rapid on-site cytologic
evaluation [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] . Strong internal
performance does not necessarily translate across cohorts. For example, a
model trained on TCGA and GTEx achieved an internal AUC of 0.997 but only 0.668
when evaluated on CPTAC; the reciprocal CPTAC-to-TCGA/GTEx transfer achieved an
AUC of 0.839 [ 34 ] . The same study showed that
dataset-specific features could dominate class-specific morphology,
illustrating the need for independent, geographically distinct validation
data.

blocks.en: Against this background, we introduce an institutional multimodal PDAC dataset collected at University Medical Center Göttingen. The dataset combines multiple H&E WSIs per patient with structured clinicopathological variables, targeted panel sequencing, and long-term overall-survival data. It complements TCGA-PAAD and CPTAC-PDA by providing an independent patient population with linked histological, clinical, molecular, and outcome information. To characterise the dataset and facilitate future comparisons, we report initial survival-prediction benchmarks using individual modalities and multimodal combinations. These experiments are intended to establish reference performance for this cohort rather than to propose a definitive survival-prediction model. The dataset therefore provides a resource for future research on cross-cohort validation, patient-level multi-slide aggregation, multimodal learning, and pancreas-specific evaluation of pathology foundation models.

blocks.zh: 3 数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Study population and data sources
blocks.zh: 3.1 研究人口和数据来源

blocks.en:
We conducted a retrospective, single-centre cohort study of patients who underwent surgical resection for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) at University Medical Center Göttingen between 2000 and 2021. Patients who had received neoadjuvant treatment were excluded. Patients were eligible if they had documented vital status and overall survival (OS) time, an OS exceeding two months, and at least one available archival haematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide image. The two-month threshold was applied to reduce the influence of early postoperative
mortality on the survival benchmark. Of the 631 patients screened, 302 met all eligibility criteria and comprised the final study cohort. For each case, the H&E-stained slide or slides with the highest tumour cell content were selected and digitised using a Philips scanner at 40 × 40\times magnification. During follow-up, 253 patients (83.8%) died and 49 (16.2%) were alive at last follow-up and were therefore censored.

blocks.en: 3.2 Clinical variables
blocks.zh: 3.2 临床变量

blocks.en: The primary feature set comprised seven routinely available clinicopathological variables: age at diagnosis (years), sex, histological grade (G1-G3), pathological T category (pT1-pT4), pathological N category (pN0-pN2), resection-margin status (R0 vs. R1/R2), and lymph node ratio (LNR). The pT and pN categories were taken from the original pathology reports. LNR was defined as the number of tumour-involved regional lymph nodes divided by the total number of examined regional lymph nodes. LNR was selected instead of the composite UICC stage group because stage largely reflects pT and pN in resected PDAC, whereas LNR captures variation in relative nodal involvement within pN categories. An alternative feature set replacing LNR with UICC stage group (I-IV) was evaluated in a sensitivity analysis. Among patients with available nodal counts, data-quality checks confirmed that those classified as pN0 had no tumour-involved nodes and that the number of involved nodes never exceeded the number examined.
blocks.zh: 主要特征包括7个常规临床病理学变量:诊断年龄(年份)、性别、组织等级(G1-G3)、病理学T类(pT1-pT4)、病理学N类(pN0-pN2)、剖面-边缘状态(R0对R1/R2)和淋巴结比率(LNR)。 pT类和pN类取自原病理学报告. LNR被定义为肿瘤-参与的区域淋巴结数量除以被检查的区域淋巴结总数. LNR被选中,而不是综合UICC阶段组,因为舞台在重新分解的PDAC中主要反映了pT和pN,而LNR捕捉到pN类中相对节点参与的变化. 在一项敏感性分析中评价了用UICC级组(I-IV)取代LNR的替代特性集. 在有可用的节点计数的患者中,数据质量检查证实,被归类为pN0的患者没有肿瘤参与的节点,参与的节点数量从未超过被检查的数量.

blocks.en: Missing covariate data were uncommon: pT was missing in 2 patients (0.7%), resection-margin status in 5 (1.7%), LNR in 1 (0.3%), and UICC stage in 2 (0.7%). Age, sex, histological grade, and pN were complete. Missing entries were imputed using medians calculated exclusively from the corresponding training split.
blocks.zh: 缺少的同位素数据并不常见:2名病人(0.7%)缺少pT,5人(1.7%)缺乏重新剖析边缘状态,1人(0.3%)缺乏LNR状态,2人(0.7%)缺乏UICC状态。 年龄、性别、组织等级和pN都是完整的。 缺失的条目是完全根据相应的培训分配额计算的中位数估算的。

blocks.en: Targeted genomic profiling was performed on tumour DNA using a custom-designed next-generation sequencing (NGS) panel covering 102 cancer-associated genes which are listed in the Appendix 1 and 2 . The panel targeted all coding exons for the majority of genes.
blocks.zh: 对肿瘤DNA进行了有针对性的基因组分析,采用了定制的下一代测序面板,覆盖附录1和2所列的102个与癌症有关的基因。 该小组针对大多数基因的所有编码外科。

blocks.en: Tumour DNA was extracted from FFPE tissue sections of the resection specimen. Tumour-rich regions were identified on H&E-stained sections, and macrodissection was performed to enrich for tumour content. Only samples with an estimated minimum tumour cell content of 60% were processed further. Genomic DNA was isolated using the automated Maxwell® system in combination with the CSC FFPE DNA Purification Kit (Promega). DNA was fragmented on a Covaris ME220 instrument to an average fragment size of 150–200 bp and quantified using the Qubit™ dsDNA High Sensitivity Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
blocks.zh: 肿瘤DNA是从分解标本的FFPE组织部分提取的. 在H&E沾染的科中发现了肿瘤丰富的区域,并进行了宏观分解以丰富肿瘤含量。 只有估计最低肿瘤细胞含量为60%的样本得到进一步处理。 基因组DNA与CSC FFPE DNA净化箱(Promega)结合使用自动Maxwell®系统进行隔离. 脱氧核糖核酸在Covaris ME220仪器上被打碎,平均碎片大小为150-200 bp,并按照制造商的指示,使用QubitTM dsDNA 高敏度Assay Kit(Thermo Fisher Science)量化。

blocks.en: Library preparation was carried out using the SureSelect XT HS2 Kit (Agilent) with an input of 100 ng fragmented DNA, including end repair, A-tailing, adapter ligation incorporating unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) and PCR amplification. Target enrichment was performed by in-solution hybrid capture using the custom gene panel. Library preparation was automated on the NGS Star system (Hamilton). Equimolar amounts of libraries were pooled and sequenced with 150-bp paired-end reads on an Illumina NextSeq 500 platform.

blocks.en: Raw sequencing data (FASTQ files) were generated on-instrument and processed using CLC Genomics Workbench (version 21.05, Qiagen) for read alignment, variant calling and downstream analysis. Reads were aligned to the human reference genome GRCh37/hg19. Samples with a mean sequencing coverage below 100× were considered failed and excluded. Variant calling included single-nucleotide variants and small insertions or deletions. Variants were retained if they fulfilled predefined quality criteria, including a minimum read count greater than 50, minimum coverage at the variant position greater than 60×, a variant allele frequency greater than 5%, and support by at least ten unique start and end sites. UMIs were used for read annotation and duplicate collapsing using the standard UMI-processing workflow implemented in CLC Genomics Workbench.
blocks.zh: 原始测序数据(FASTQ文件)是使用CLC Genomics Workbench(21.05版,Qiagen)生成并处理的,用于读取对齐,变位调和下游分析. 读数与人类参考基因组GRCh37/hg19一致。 平均测序覆盖率低于100×的样本被认为失败并排除在外。 变位调用包括单核苷酸变位和小的插入或删除。 备选案文如果符合预先确定的质量标准,即予以保留,包括最低读数大于50,变位最小覆盖率大于60xx,变位所有频率大于5%,以及至少有10个独特的起始点和终点站的支持。 使用CLC Genomics Workbench中执行的标准UMI处理工作流程,UMI用于读取注释和重复崩溃。

blocks.en: Detected variants were interpreted using established clinical knowledge bases (ClinVar and OncoKB) and classified as pathogenic or likely pathogenic, variants of uncertain significance, or benign or likely benign. For the present analysis, KRAS and TP53 mutation status was defined as the presence of at least one pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in the respective gene.
blocks.zh: 检测到的变体使用已建立的临床知识库(ClinVar和OncoKB)进行解释,并被归类为致病性或可能的致病性,具有不确定意义的变体,或良性或可能良性。 就本分析而言,KRAS和TP53突变状态被定义为相关基因中至少有一种病原或可能的病原变异。

The pair ( y i , δ i ) (y_{i},\delta_{i}) constituted the observed outcome label. For censored patients, this label indicated survival up to the censoring time rather than death within the assigned interval. The ISD, represented by the predicted survival function S ^ i ​ ( t ) \hat{S}_{i}(t) , was a model output evaluated against these observed outcomes, not a directly observed ground-truth distribution.

blocks.en: 3.4 Cross-validation design
blocks.zh: 3.4 交叉验证设计

blocks.en: Model performance was evaluated using five repetitions of Monte Carlo cross-validation(MCCV). In each repetition, the full cohort of 302 patients was randomly partitioned at the patient level into mutually exclusive training ( n = 152 n=152 ), validation ( n = 75 n=75 ), and test ( n = 75 n=75 ) sets in an approximately 2:1:1 ratio, with stratification by event status. Partitions were sampled independently across repetitions. The five partitions were generated once using a fixed random seed and stored for reuse, ensuring that all models and feature representations were trained and evaluated on identical patient splits. Although the three sets were disjoint within each repetition, test sets could overlap across repetitions, as expected in Monte Carlo cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 模型性能通过蒙特卡洛交叉验证(MCCV)的5次重复评价. 每次重复时,302名患者的完整组群在患者一级被随机划分为相互排斥的训练(n = 152 n = 152),验证(n = 75 n = 75),测试(n = 75 n = 75)套群大约为2:1:1比例,按事件状态分层. 隔断部分在重复中单独取样。 五个分区曾经使用固定的随机种子生成,并存储用于再利用,确保所有模型和特征表示都经过培训和对相同的病人分区进行评估。 虽然三套在每套重复中是脱节的,但测试集在重复中可能会重叠,如蒙特卡洛交叉验证时所预期的那样.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 基准

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: We evaluated OS prediction using three information sources: routine clinicopathological variables, tumour mutation status, and diagnostic whole-slide images (WSIs). The benchmark distinguished three design components: the input configuration (which information sources were included), the encoding backbone (how inputs were transformed into features), and the survival model (how these features were mapped to survival predictions). Fourteen configurations were evaluated (Table 2 ), encompassing numeric covariates, text representations of the same covariates generated using two frozen language encoders, WSI-derived features, and multimodal image-text fusion.
blocks.zh: 我们利用三个信息来源评估了OS预测:常规临床病理学变量、肿瘤突变状况和诊断性全滑坡图像。 基准区分了三个设计部分:输入配置(包含信息来源),编码主干(输入如何转化为特征),生存模型(这些特征是如何映射到生存预测的). 评价了14个配置(表2),包括数字共变、使用两个冷冻语言编码器生成的相同共变的文字表示、WSI衍生的特性以及多式联运图像文本组合。

blocks.en: Model performance was evaluated using five repetitions of Monte Carlo cross-validation. In each repetition, patients were randomly assigned to training ( n = 152 n=152 ), validation ( n = 75 n=75 ), and test ( n = 75 n=75 ) sets in an approximately 2:1:1 ratio, with stratification by event status. Patient-level partitions were generated independently across repetitions and reused for all models. Evaluation was performed on the same held-out test sets using a common outcome definition and performance metric. Two baseline models were included: ridge-regularised Cox regression and a deep survival network, both using the same numeric covariates. These baselines were used to compare survival modelling approaches and assess whether alternative input representations or additional data sources improved predictive performance.
blocks.zh: 模型性能通过蒙特卡洛交叉验证的五次重复评价. 每次重复时,患者被随机分配到训练(n = 152 n = 152),验证(n = 75 n = 75),测试(n = 75 n = 75)设置在大约2:1:1的比例,按事件状态分层. 患者级别的分区通过重复独立生成,并重新用于所有模型. 使用共同的成果定义和业绩衡量标准,对相同的搁置测试进行了评价。 列入了两个基准模型: 考克斯回归和一个深层生存网络,两者使用相同的数值共变. 这些基线被用来比较生存建模方法,并评估替代输入表示或额外数据来源是否改善了预测性能。

blocks.en: 4.2 Input representations
blocks.zh: 4.2 投入说明

blocks.en: Seven routinely available clinicopathological variables including age at diagnosis, sex, histological grade, pT, pN, resection-margin status, and lymph node ratio were encoded as a seven-dimensional numeric vector. The extended feature set included two additional binary indicators for pathogenic mutations in TP53 and KRAS . Mutation status was recorded as missing for patients without sequencing data. Within each cross-validation repetition, missing values were imputed using per-variable training-set medians, and all variables were standardised using training-set means and standard deviations. These preprocessing parameters were applied unchanged to the validation and test sets.
blocks.zh: 7个常规临床病理学变量,包括诊断时的年龄、性别、组织学等级、pT、pN、剖面-边缘状态和淋巴结比率,被编码为七维数字矢量。 扩展的特征集包括TP53和KRAS两个额外的致病突变二进制指标。 对于没有排序数据的患者来说,突变状态被记录为缺失. 在每次交叉验证重复中,缺失值都是用每组可变培训中位数估算的,所有变量都使用培训中位数和标准偏差进行标准化。 这些预处理参数在验证和测试集中未作改动。

blocks.en: Each patient’s covariates were converted into a short description using fixed sentence templates and standard TNM terminology. Missing values were represented as “not reported” rather than imputed. The descriptions therefore used the same source variables as the numeric inputs, while retaining missingness explicitly.
blocks.zh: 每个病人的同位素被用固定的句子模板和标准TNM术语转换成一个简短的描述. 缺失的数值是“未报告”而不是估算的。 因此,说明使用与数字输入相同的源变量,同时明确保留缺失。

blocks.en: Descriptions were encoded using two frozen models: (i) BioClinical ModernBERT [ 52 ] , a long-context encoder based on the ModernBERT architecture [ 53 ] and pretrained on biomedical and clinical text; and (ii) the text encoder of CONCH [ 47 ] , a vision-language foundation model for computational pathology that produces 512-dimensional text embeddings.
blocks.zh: 描述使用两个冷冻模型编码:(一)BioClinical ModernBERT[52],一个基于ModernBERT架构的长文本编码器[53],并预训生物医学和临床文本;和(二)CONCH的文本编码器[47],一个用于计算病理学的视觉语言基础模型,生成512维文本嵌入.

blocks.en: WSIs were divided into non-overlapping patches. Each patch was encoded using the frozen CONCH image encoder [ 47 ] to obtain a 512-dimensional embedding. CONCH’s image and text encoders produce representations in a shared embedding space, which was used for image-text fusion.
blocks.zh: WSI被分为非重叠补丁. 每个补丁都使用冷冻的CONCH图像编码器[47]进行编码,以获得512维嵌入. CONCH的图像和文本编码器在一个共享的嵌入空间中产生表示,用于图像-文本组合.

blocks.en: 4.3 Whole-slide token selection
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 全滑符号选择

blocks.en: The patch set of each slide was reduced using the deterministic, concept-guided FOCUS procedure [ 54 ] . Patch relevance was assessed using contrast scoring based on similarity to a bank of 22 pancreatic-pathology text prompts (14 tumour-related and 8 background concepts), embedded with the frozen CONCH text encoder. Redundant neighbouring patches were pruned using an embedding-similarity threshold of 0.9.
blocks.zh: 每张幻灯片的补丁集采用确定性、概念指导FOCUS程序减少[54]。 对补丁关联性进行了评估,根据与22个胰腺-病理学文本提示(14个肿瘤相关概念和8个背景概念)的库的相似性进行了对比评分,并嵌入了冻结的CONCH文本编码器。 使用0.9的嵌入-同质阈值对相邻的冗余补丁进行挤压。

blocks.zh: 4.4 生存模式

blocks.en: All models produced survival estimates on a common evaluation time grid. These estimates were converted to scalar risk scores using the same definition for concordance evaluation.

blocks.en: A Cox proportional-hazards model [ 55 ] with ℓ 2 \ell_{2} (ridge) regularisation was fitted using scikit-survival [ 56 ] .

blocks.en: Histological information was modelled using the concept-guided FOCUS architecture [ 54 ] . The selected patch tokens were projected into the model’s concept space and processed using multi-head cross-attention. Tumour-concept embeddings served as queries, while the projected patch tokens served as keys and values. The resulting concept-specific representations were combined using learned attention pooling and passed to the discrete-time survival head described above.
blocks.zh: 利用概念指导的FOCUS架构模拟了历史信息 [54]. 选定的补丁符号被投射到模型的概念空间中,并用多头交叉注意处理. 肿瘤概念嵌入作为查询,而预测的补丁符号则作为密钥和值. 由此产生的针对具体概念的表述是利用汲取的注意力加以合并,并传给上文所述的离散时间生存头目。

blocks.en: Multimodal fusion was implemented using the co-attention mechanism of MCAT [ 8 ] . The genomic tokens used in the original architecture were replaced by nine CONCH-derived text tokens including one for each of the seven clinicopathological variables and two mutation indicators. Because the image and text tokens were generated by the paired CONCH encoders, they occupied a shared pretrained embedding space before fusion. Each text token served as a query in single-head scaled dot-product attention over the patient’s WSI tokens, which served as keys and values. This produced one image-conditioned representation for each input variable.
blocks.zh: 采用MCAT[8]的共同参与机制实施了多式联运组合。 原建筑中使用的基因组代币被9个CONCH衍生的文字代币所取代,包括7个临床病理变量和2个变异指标各1个. 由于图像和文本符号是由配对的CONCH编码器生成的,它们在聚变前占据了共享的预先训练的嵌入空间. 每个文本符号都作为病人WSI符号的单头缩放点产品注意力的查询,而WSI符号则是键和值。 这为每个输入变量产生了一个图像条件下的表示。

blocks.en: The image-conditioned representations and the original text tokens were aggregated separately using gated attention pooling [ 59 ] . The two pooled vectors were concatenated, projected to a 64-dimensional patient representation, and passed to the discrete-time survival head described above. Only the co-attention component of MCAT was adopted; the transformer encoders from the original architecture were not used.
blocks.zh: 以图像为条件的表示物和原始文字符号分别使用门式的注意力集合[59]进行汇总. 两个集合的载体被凝固,投射到64维的患者代表,并传递到上述离散时间存活头. 只采用了MCAT的共通组件;没有使用原架构的变压器编码器.

blocks.en: 4.5 Evaluation and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 评价和统计分析

blocks.en: The primary performance measure was Harrell’s concordance index [ 60 ] , which assesses the ability of predicted risk scores to rank survival outcomes using patient pairs comparable under right censoring. For each model, concordance was calculated on the held-out test set of each repetition and summarised as mean ± \pm standard deviation across the five Monte Carlo repetitions. All models additionally generated patient-specific ISDs, represented by predicted survival probabilities at the prespecified six-month evaluation time points.
blocks.zh: 主要的绩效衡量标准是Harrell的校正指数[60],该指数评估了预测的风险分数是否有能力利用在正确审查下可比较的病人对子对存活结果进行排序。 对于每个模型,在每次重复的搁置测试中计算出一致性,并概括为5次蒙特卡洛重复的平均值±\pm标准差. 所有模型都额外生成了针对患者的ISD,以预先指定的6个月评价时间点的预测存活概率为代表.

blocks.en: Continuous variables were summarised as medians with interquartile ranges (IQRs), and categorical variables as counts and percentages. Survival curves and median follow-up were estimated using the Kaplan–Meier and reverse Kaplan-Meier methods, respectively.
blocks.zh: 连续变量被归纳为中位数,中间值为方差(IQRs),绝对变量被归纳为计数和百分比。 分别采用Kaplan-Meier和逆向Kaplan-Meier方法估计了生存曲线和中位跟踪。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Table 2 reports test-set concordance for all fourteen evaluated configurations. These analyses were conducted to establish initial reference values for survival prediction in the institutional PDAC cohort. They are intended to support future model development and comparison using this dataset, rather than to identify a definitive modelling strategy. Five observations summarise the benchmark results.
blocks.zh: 表2汇报了所有14个评价组合的测试设置一致性。 进行这些分析是为了确定机构性多指标类集评估中生存预测的初步参考值。 它们旨在利用这一数据集支持未来的模型开发和比较,而不是确定一个确定的建模战略。 五项意见总结了基准结果。

blocks.en: Using the seven numeric clinicopathological variables, ridge-regularised Cox regression achieved a mean C-index of 0.649 ± 0.042 0.649\pm 0.042 , whereas the deep discrete-time model achieved 0.599 ± 0.040 0.599\pm 0.040 . These results provide linear and neural reference values for the clinical feature set. The difference between the models should be interpreted in light of their fitting protocols: the Cox model was fitted using the combined training and validation sets ( n = 227 n=227 ), whereas the neural model was fitted on the training set ( n = 152 n=152 ), with the validation set used for epoch selection. The comparison therefore does not isolate the effect of model class alone.
blocks.zh: 利用7个数值临床病理变量,脊调节Cox回归实现平均C-指数0.649±0.042 0.649\pm 0.042,而深离散时间模型实现0.599±0.040 0.599\pm. 0.040 (英语). 这些结果为临床特征集提供了线性和神经参考值. 模型之间的区别应当根据其配装协议来解释:Cox模型是使用组合培训和验证成套设备(n = 227 n = 227)安装的,而神经模型则安装在训练成套设备(n = 152 n = 152)上,验证成套用于划时代选择. 因此,这种比较并不孤立模式类的影响。

blocks.en: After the mutation status of TP53 and KRAS was added, the mean C-index of the Cox model changed from 0.649 ± 0.042 0.649\pm 0.042 to 0.652 ± 0.046 0.652\pm 0.046 . The latter was the highest mean concordance observed in the benchmark, although the numerical increase was only 0.003. For the deep discrete-time model, concordance changed from 0.599 ± 0.040 0.599\pm 0.040 to 0.589 ± 0.060 0.589\pm 0.060 . Thus, the addition of mutation status did not produce a consistent improvement across the two modelling approaches. These values serve as initial reference results and do not establish the incremental prognostic value of the mutation variables.
blocks.zh: 在添加TP53和KRAS的变异状态后,Cox模型的平均值C-index从0.649±0.042 0.649\pm 0.042改为0.652±0.046 0.652\pm. 0.046 (英语). 后者是基准中最高的中间一致性,尽管数字增长只有0.003。 对于深离散时间模型,校正从0.599±0.040 0.599\pm 0.040改为0.589±0.060 0.589\pm. 0.060 (英语). 因此,增加突变状态并不能在两种模型方法之间产生一致的改进。 这些值作为初始参考结果,并不确定变异变量的增量预测值.

blocks.en: For the mutation-extended feature set, Cox regression achieved a mean C-index of 0.652 using the numeric variables, compared with 0.594 using BioClinical ModernBERT embeddings and 0.538 using CONCH text embeddings. For the clinical-only feature set, performance also varied according to the combination of text encoder and survival model. CONCH embeddings achieved mean concordance values of 0.594 with the deep reader and 0.562 with the Cox reader, whereas BioClinical ModernBERT embeddings achieved 0.558 and 0.594, respectively. These results establish baseline performance for frozen text representations of the tabular variables. Differences between encoders or readers are reported descriptively because the benchmark was not designed to determine their underlying causes.
blocks.zh: 对于变异扩展的特征集,Cox回归使用数值变量实现平均C-指数0.652,而使用BioClinical ModernBERT嵌入的C-指数为0.594,使用CONCH文本嵌入的C-指数为0.538. 对于只临床的特征集,性能也根据文本编码器和生存模型的组合而有所不同. CONCH嵌入法实现了0.594与深读器和0.562与Cox读器的中间对齐值,而BioClinic ModernBERT嵌入法则分别实现了0.558和0.594. 这些结果为表格变量的冻结文本表述确定了基线绩效。 编码者或阅读者之间的差异在描述性上报告,因为基准不是用来确定其根本原因的。

blocks.en: Using WSIs alone, the concept-guided attention model achieved a mean C-index of 0.603 ± 0.030 0.603\pm 0.030 , the highest value among the single-modality neural configurations. Ridge Cox regression applied to the mean-pooled image representation achieved 0.570 ± 0.021 0.570\pm 0.021 . Although both configurations used CONCH patch embeddings and identical data partitions, they differed in token selection, aggregation, survival model, and fitting protocol. The difference of 0.033 therefore describes the performance of the complete image-analysis pipelines and cannot be attributed to aggregation alone.
blocks.zh: 仅使用WSIs,概念引导关注模型就实现了平均C-指数0.603±0.030 0.603\pm 0.030,是单模式神经构型中最高值. 山脊 Cox回归应用于平均集合图像表示法实现0.570±0.021 0.570\pm 0.021. 虽然两种配置都使用了CONCH补丁嵌入和相同的数据分区,但它们在符号选择,聚合,生存模型,以及配对协议上都有所不同. 因此,0.033的差值描述了完整的图像分析管道的性能,不能单独归因于聚合.

blocks.en: Co-attention fusion of WSI tokens with CONCH-derived tokens representing the clinical and mutation variables achieved a mean C-index of 0.619 ± 0.025 0.619\pm 0.025 . This was the highest mean concordance among the neural configurations and represented numerical increases of 0.016 over the image-only attention model, 0.071 over the corresponding text-only model, and 0.030 over the deep model using the mutation-extended numeric feature set. For the linear Cox models, the combined pooled image-text representation achieved a mean C-index of 0.594, compared with 0.570 for the image representation and 0.538 for the text representation.
blocks.zh: 将WSI信物与代表临床和变异变量的CONCH信物合用,实现平均C-指数0.619±0.025 0.619\pm 0.025 (英语). 这是神经构型中最高的均和度,代表数字比只注意图像模型增加0.016,比相应的只注意文本模型增加0.071,比使用突变扩展数字特征集的深模型增加0.030. 对于线性Cox模型,集成图像-文本代表实现平均C-指数0.594,而图像代表为0.570,文本代表为0.538。

blocks.en: The fused neural model remained below the clinical-only and mutation-extended numeric Cox baselines ( 0.619 0.619 vs. 0.649 0.649 and 0.652 0.652 , respectively). Its across-repetition standard deviation was 0.025 0.025 , compared with 0.042 0.042 for the clinical-only Cox model; given the five repetitions, this difference is descriptive rather than evidence of greater stability. The fusion model additionally generated per-variable co-attention maps over the WSI tokens. These maps provide material for subsequent analysis but are not treated as validated explanations in the present benchmark.
blocks.zh: 被保险的神经模型仍然低于仅临床和变异的Cox数值基线(分别为0.619 0.619对0.649 0.649和0.652 0.652)。 其跨重复标准偏差为0.025 0.025,而仅临床型号为0.042 0.042;鉴于这5次重复,这一差异是描述性的,而不是更稳定的证据. 聚变模型在WSI符号上额外生成了可变的同心图. 这些地图为随后的分析提供了材料,但在本基准中不被视为经过验证的解释。

blocks.en: Overall, these results establish initial performance references for clinical, molecular, histological, and multimodal survival models applied to the institutional cohort. Further model development and external validation will be required to assess whether these findings generalise beyond this dataset.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果为临床、分子、组织学和适用于机构组群的多模式生存模型确立了初步性能参考。 需要进一步开发模型和进行外部验证,以评估这些调查结果是否超出本数据集。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present a multimodal dataset from an institutional cohort of patients with resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, linking digitised H&E whole-slide images with routinely collected clinicopathological variables, targeted mutation data, and long-term overall-survival outcomes. By integrating these data at the patient level, the dataset expands the limited resources available for pancreas-specific computational pathology and enables clinical, molecular, histological, and multimodal approaches to be evaluated using a common outcome definition.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了一个多模式的数据集,来自一批经重新剖析的胰腺沟渠瘤患者,将数字化的H&E全滑坡图像与常规收集的临床病理学变量、有针对性的突变数据和长期总体存活结果联系起来。 通过在病人一级综合这些数据,数据集扩大了可用于胰腺特定计算病理学的有限资源,并使临床、分子、组织学和多式联运方法能够使用共同的结果定义进行评价。

blocks.en: To provide initial reference values, we evaluated fourteen combinations of input representation, feature-encoding backbone, and survival model. Ridge-regularised Cox regression using numeric clinicopathological and mutation variables achieved the highest mean concordance in this benchmark (C-index 0.652 ± 0.046 0.652\pm 0.046 ). The image-only attention model supported survival discrimination from histology alone (C-index 0.603 ± 0.030 0.603\pm 0.030 ), while multimodal co-attention achieved the highest concordance among the neural configurations (C-index 0.619 ± 0.025 0.619\pm 0.025 ). Representing tabular covariates using frozen text embeddings did not improve mean concordance over their numeric representation. These findings should be interpreted as initial dataset benchmarks rather than evidence of an optimal survival-modelling strategy.
blocks.zh: 为了提供初步的参考值,我们评价了十四种组合,即输入表示、特征编码主干和生存模型。 山脊正规化 使用数字临床病理和变异变量的考克斯回归在这个基准(C-index 0.652 ± 0.046 0.652/pm 0.046)中实现了最高的平均值一致. 仅图像关注模式支持仅从神学上生存歧视(C-index 0.603±0.030 0.603\pm 0.030),而多模式共关注则实现了神经构型中最高的一致(C-index 0.619± 0.025 0.619\pm 0.025). 使用冷冻文本嵌入法代表表式共变物,并不能改善它们的数字代表的表示。 这些结论应解释为初步数据集基准,而不是最佳生存模式战略的证据。

blocks.en: The dataset and its accompanying benchmarks provide a foundation for future research on pancreas-specific foundation models, patient-level WSI aggregation, multimodal survival modelling, and cross-cohort validation.
blocks.zh: 数据集及其配套基准为今后研究胰腺特异性基模型、患者层面的WSI聚合、多式联运生存模型和跨曲线验证提供了基础。
